LapakVendor.title: LapakVendor
LapakVendor.description: Public vendor portal document synced from the Lapak Kita Admin app for a specific consignor/seller.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Lapak Kita Admin who owns this vendor.

vendorCode.description: Unique vendor portal code in LPK-XXXXXX format matching the document ID.

localSellerId.description: Local Room Seller ID on the Admin device.

sellerName.description: Display name of the vendor/kitchen (Nama Dapur Penyetor).

VendorAuthSecret.title: VendorAuthSecret
VendorAuthSecret.description: Admin-only private secret document storing the writeToken used to authorize Web Penyetor submissions.

VendorSubmission.title: VendorSubmission
VendorSubmission.description: Write-authenticated submission from the public Web Penyetor containing new products, product edits, and daily stock deliveries.

LapakTransactionRecord.title: LapakTransactionRecord
LapakTransactionRecord.description: Cloud-synced sales transaction record with itemized consignor revenue split and admin commission for real-time financial reporting.

LapakExpenseRecord.title: LapakExpenseRecord
LapakExpenseRecord.description: Cloud-synced operating expense record for Lapak Kita financial ledger.

LapakSettlementRecord.title: LapakSettlementRecord
LapakSettlementRecord.description: Cloud-synced seller payout/settlement record tracking amounts paid to each kitchen/consignor.

LicenseCode.title: LicenseCode
LicenseCode.description: One-device permanent activation license code for the Lapak Kita Admin Android app.

code.description: Unique uppercase license code (e.g. LPK-XXXX-XXXX) matching the document ID.

buyerNote.description: Optional buyer name or purchase note added by developer.

isUsed.description: Whether the license has been claimed by a device.

usedByDeviceId.description: Stable Android device identifier bound on first activation.

usedAt.description: Server timestamp when the license was activated.

createdByUid.description: Developer Firebase Auth UID who generated the code.

/lapak_vendors/{vendorCode}.description: Vendor portal state synced by Admin and read by the corresponding vendor using their unique vendorCode.

/lapak_vendors/{vendorCode}/private/{doc.description: Private admin-only subcollection storing writeToken at docId='auth'.

/lapak_vendor_submissions/{submissionId}.description: Vendor web portal submissions listened in real-time by the owning Admin.

/lapak_transactions/{transactionDocId}.description: Admin-owned sales transactions synced in real-time for financial reporting and cross-device recovery.

/lapak_expenses/{expenseDocId}.description: Admin-owned operating expenses synced in real-time for financial reporting.

/lapak_settlements/{settlementDocId}.description: Admin-owned seller payout settlements synced in real-time for consignor recap reports.

/license_codes/{licenseCode}.description: Device-bound license activation codes generated by the Developer Admin and claimed once per device.
